name: Chawchamp
look: a squat bullfrog brawler with one swollen cheek full of chaw, a brass championship belt and taped fists
entry: Chawchamp constantly chews on bitter herbs to stay focused during sparring matches. Its jaw strength can crush a Geodude.
how: Wild: uncommon in the Ashtray Wastes (an overworld biome added by CobbleEffort: Kanto).
It learns Spittoon Slug at level 17.
